fact: Business Daily reports KRA allowed taxpayers five more days from 1 July 2025 to file annual returns and pay taxes due 30 June after the iTax system crashed under deadline traffic.

TNX Africa reports that National Treasury Principal Secretary Chris Kiptoo told the National Assembly Finance Committee on 27 October 2026 that the Treasury manages eCitizen, the government's digital payment platform, as the entity in charge of revenue collection, and the article says it processes billions in public revenue.

The Star reports Nairobi County's e-JijiPay, run by JamboPay, collects single business permits, market fees, cess, slaughter and auction fees and parking through an electronic system, while most counties automated only a small share of revenue streams.
Since a 17 November 2023 notice, stamp duty is paid electronically through Ardhipay on the Ardhisasa portal by M-PESA Paybill 222222 or bank RTGS, per ANO Advocates.
